name: Alameda County Social Services Agency
description: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh (food stamps), CalWORKs and General Assistance applications for Alameda County residents.
fullDescription: The county agency that accepts and processes Medi-Cal, CalFresh (food stamps), CalWORKs and General Assistance applications for Alameda County residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medi-Cal applications, renewals and eligibility questions
- CalFresh (food stamps) applications and recertification
- CalWORKs cash aid for families with children
- General Assistance for adults without children
- In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) intake
howToGetIt:
Apply online at BenefitsCal.com any time, or call the agency. Self Sufficiency Centers in Oakland, Hayward, Fremont, Livermore and Eden take walk-ins — call first to confirm hours.

You can apply at any time of year. Bring photo ID, proof of income and proof of address if you have them, but a missing document is not a reason to delay applying.
